# QSARena options reference

<!-- Generated by `python -m qsarena.config --write-docs`; do not edit by hand. -->

Every workflow decision is one key of `RunConfig` (`qsarena/config.py`). A key can be set in a
`run.yaml` passed with `qsarena-benchmark --config run.yaml`, or with the listed command-line flag.
Precedence is **command-line flag > config file > built-in default**. The resolved configuration and
its signature are written to `run_config.json` in every run directory. Keys marked *per dataset*
may also be overridden per row of a batch manifest.

The notebook column lists the `# @param` widget of `colab_qsar_tutorial.ipynb` implementing the same
decision; step 0B of the notebook loads a `run.yaml` into those widgets and the last step exports
the widgets back to a `run.yaml`.

## 1. Input & columns

| Key | Default | Allowed values | CLI flag | Notebook widget | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `input.path` | `null` | path/name or list | `--dataset` | CLI / run.yaml only | CSV file (or list of CSV files) for single mode. Each file becomes one dataset named after it. |
| `input.smiles_col` | `null` (auto-detect (QSAR_READY_SMILES, canonical_smiles, SMILES, smiles, Smiles)) | text | `--smiles-col` | `smiles_column` | Column holding the SMILES strings. *Per dataset.* |
| `input.target_col` | `null` (auto-detect (TARGET, target, Target, ...)) | path/name or list | `--target-col` | `target_column` | Target column. A list runs one dataset per target (named <file>__<target>). *Per dataset.* |
| `input.id_col` | `null` | text | `--id-col` | CLI / run.yaml only | Optional identifier column, copied into the per-dataset predictions.csv. *Per dataset.* |
| `input.task` | `auto` | `auto`, `regression`, `classification` | `--task` | CLI / run.yaml only | auto treats a target with exactly two values as classification and anything else as regression. *Per dataset.* |
| `input.classification_threshold` | `null` | float | `--classification-threshold` | CLI / run.yaml only | Binarize a continuous target: value >= threshold becomes 1, otherwise 0. Implies task: classification. *Per dataset.* |
| `input.target_transform` | `auto` | `auto`, `raw`, `log10` | `--target-transform` | CLI / run.yaml only | auto keeps curated benchmark datasets on their raw scale and log10-transforms a user regression target when every value is positive. Classification targets are never transformed. *Per dataset.* |
| `input.minimum_rows` | `20` | int (>= 2) | `--minimum-rows` | CLI / run.yaml only | Skip a dataset with fewer valid rows than this after cleanup (small-dataset guardrail). *Per dataset.* |
| `input.row_limit` | `0` | int (>= 0) | `--row-limit` | CLI / run.yaml only | Deterministic random subsample of this many rows (0 = use every row). Meant for smoke tests. *Per dataset.* |

## 2. Standardization

| Key | Default | Allowed values | CLI flag | Notebook widget | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `standardize.drop_unparseable` | `true` | true / false | `--drop-unparseable / --no-drop-unparseable` | CLI / run.yaml only | true drops rows RDKit cannot parse and reports how many. false stops the dataset with an error listing the unparseable rows, so nothing is dropped silently. *Per dataset.* |
| `standardize.strip_salts` | `false` | true / false | `--strip-salts / --no-strip-salts` | CLI / run.yaml only | Keep only the largest organic fragment (RDKit LargestFragmentChooser). *Per dataset.* |
| `standardize.normalize_charges` | `false` | true / false | `--normalize-charges / --no-normalize-charges` | CLI / run.yaml only | Neutralize charges where possible (RDKit Uncharger). *Per dataset.* |
| `standardize.normalize_tautomers` | `false` | true / false | `--normalize-tautomers / --no-normalize-tautomers` | CLI / run.yaml only | Replace each molecule with RDKit's canonical tautomer. Slower, and can change the drawn structure. *Per dataset.* |
| `standardize.deduplicate` | `"none"` | `none`, `exact`, `canonical_smiles` | `--deduplicate` | `collapse_duplicate_canonical_smiles` | none keeps every row; exact drops rows repeating both the input SMILES and the target; canonical_smiles merges rows with the same canonical structure (mean target for regression, majority label for classification). *Per dataset.* |

## 3. Featurization

| Key | Default | Allowed values | CLI flag | Notebook widget | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `features.families` | `[morgan, ecfp6, fcfp6, layered, atom_pair, topological_torsion, rdk_path, maccs, rdkit]` | list of `morgan`, `ecfp6`, `fcfp6`, `layered`, `atom_pair`, `topological_torsion`, `rdk_path`, `maccs`, `rdkit`, `maplight` (aliases: `avalon`->`maplight`, `erg`->`maplight`) | `--feature-families` | `use_morgan_features`, `use_ecfp6_features`, `use_fcfp6_features`, `use_layered_features`, `use_atom_pair_features`, `use_topological_torsion_features`, `use_rdk_path_features`, `use_maccs_keys`, `use_rdkit_descriptors` | Molecular feature families concatenated into the model matrix. 'maplight' (the MapLight-classic composite) is normally switched by features.maplight_classic; 'avalon' and 'erg' exist only inside that composite and are accepted as aliases for it. *Per dataset.* |
| `features.maplight_classic` | `true` | true / false | `--maplight-classic / --no-maplight-classic` | `use_maplight_classic` | Add the MapLight-classic composite (Morgan counts + Avalon counts + ErG + RDKit descriptor panel). *Per dataset.* |
| `features.fingerprint_bits` | `1024` | int (>= 64) | `--fingerprint-bits` | `fingerprint_bits` | Bit length of the hashed fingerprint families. *Per dataset.* |
| `features.cache` | `true` | true / false | `--enable-shared-feature-matrix-cache / --reuse-shared-feature-matrix-cache` | CLI / run.yaml only | Cache whole feature matrices (content-addressed by SMILES, families and bits) and reuse them across datasets and runs. |
| `features.persistent_store` | `true` | true / false | `--enable-persistent-feature-store / --reuse-persistent-feature-store` | `enable_persistent_feature_store`, `reuse_persistent_feature_store` | Per-SMILES Parquet feature store so only new molecules are featurized. |

## 4. Splitting

| Key | Default | Allowed values | CLI flag | Notebook widget | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `split.strategy` | `target_quartile` | `target_quartile`, `random`, `scaffold`, `predefined` (aliases: `target_quartiles`->`target_quartile`, `stratified`->`target_quartile`) | `--split-strategy` | `data_split_strategy` | target_quartile stratifies the random split on target quartiles (falls back to random when that is impossible); scaffold keeps Bemis-Murcko scaffolds together; predefined reads split.predefined_split_col. Curated benchmark datasets keep their published split. *Per dataset.* |
| `split.test_fraction` | `0.2` | float (>= 0.05, <= 0.5) | `--test-fraction` | `test_fraction` | Held-out test fraction. *Per dataset.* |
| `split.seed` | `13` | int | `--random-seed` | `model_random_seed` | Seed for the split, CV folds and every seeded model. *Per dataset.* |
| `split.cv_folds` | `5` | int (>= 2) | `--cv-folds` | `cv_folds` | Cross-validation folds on the training split (CV metrics, OOF stacking, CV selection). *Per dataset.* |
| `split.predefined_split_col` | `null` | text | `--predefined-split-col` | CLI / run.yaml only | Column whose values are train/test (or training/holdout); used when strategy is predefined. *Per dataset.* |

## 5. Feature selection

| Key | Default | Allowed values | CLI flag | Notebook widget | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `feature_selection.method` | `elasticnetcv` | `elasticnetcv`, `rf_fallback`, `none` (aliases: `elasticnet_cv`->`elasticnetcv`, `rf_importance`->`rf_fallback`, `random_forest`->`rf_fallback`) | `--selector-method` | `feature_selector_method` | Train-only selection. elasticnetcv falls back to random-forest importance on timeout; rf_fallback uses random-forest importance directly; none keeps every column. *Per dataset.* |
| `feature_selection.variance_threshold` | `1e-08` | float (>= 0.0) | `--variance-threshold` | CLI / run.yaml only | Drop columns whose training variance is at or below this value. *Per dataset.* |
| `feature_selection.binary_prevalence_range` | `[0.005, 0.995]` | [low, high] | `--binary-prevalence-range` | CLI / run.yaml only | Keep a 0/1 column only if its training prevalence lies inside [low, high]. *Per dataset.* |
| `feature_selection.drop_duplicate_columns` | `true` | true / false | `--drop-duplicate-columns / --no-drop-duplicate-columns` | CLI / run.yaml only | Drop feature columns identical to an earlier column on the training rows. *Per dataset.* |
| `feature_selection.max_selected_features` | `0` | int (>= 0) | `--max-selected-features` | CLI / run.yaml only | 0 caps the selection at ceil(10% of training rows); a positive value overrides. *Per dataset.* |
| `feature_selection.auto_rf_by_dataset_size` | `null` (profile default (on for cost_optimized/quick, off for full)) | true / false | `--selector-auto-rf-by-dataset-size / --no-selector-auto-rf-by-dataset-size` | CLI / run.yaml only | Switch to random-forest importance up front when ElasticNetCV is predicted to exceed its time limit. *Per dataset.* |
| `feature_selection.elasticnet_timeout_seconds` | `7200.0` | float (>= 1.0) | `--selector-elasticnet-timeout-seconds` | CLI / run.yaml only | Wall-clock limit for the ElasticNetCV selector before falling back to random forest. *Per dataset.* |

## 6. Model library

| Key | Default | Allowed values | CLI flag | Notebook widget | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `models.profile` | `cost_optimized` | `cost_optimized`, `full`, `quick` | `--benchmark-profile` | CLI / run.yaml only | cost_optimized (default) drops historically low-value expensive variants; full restores them; quick keeps only the scikit-learn families plus fusion and ensembles (minutes on a laptop). |
| `models.enable_families` | all `true` | mapping of `conventional_ml`, `gradient_boosting`, `deep_tabular`, `graph_nn`, `pretrained_3d`, `maplight_gnn`, `fusion`, `ensemble` to true/false | `--disable-model-families` | `run_maplight_gnn` | Master switch per model family: conventional_ml = scikit-learn models: ElasticNetCV/LogisticRegression, SVR/SVC, random forest, extra trees, HistGradientBoosting, KNN+SVM voting, AdaBoost, tabular MLP (and their GA-tuned versions); gradient_boosting = XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost and MapLight CatBoost (needs qsarena[boosting]); deep_tabular = ChemML MLP (PyTorch/TensorFlow), tabular CNN (TensorFlow) and TabPFN (needs qsarena[deep] / qsarena[foundation]); graph_nn = Chemprop v2 graph variants (needs qsarena[graph]); pretrained_3d = Uni-Mol V1/V2 pretrained 3D models (needs qsarena[foundation]; V2 needs a GPU); maplight_gnn = MapLight + GNN (CatBoost on MapLight features plus GIN embeddings; needs dgl/dgllife); fusion = CFA combinatorial fusion; ensemble = OOF stacking / weighted / simple-average ensembles. *Per dataset.* |
| `models.disable_models` | `[]` | text | `--disable-model` | CLI / run.yaml only | Model labels to skip, exactly as they appear in metrics.csv (e.g. "Tabular CNN"). *Per dataset.* |
| `models.only_models` | `[]` | text | `--only-model-names` | CLI / run.yaml only | If non-empty, run only these model labels (plus the ensemble when 'Ensemble' is listed). *Per dataset.* |

## 7. GA tuning

| Key | Default | Allowed values | CLI flag | Notebook widget | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ga_tuning.mode` | `"off"` | `off`, `on`, `auto` | `--ga-models off\|on\|auto` | CLI / run.yaml only | off skips GA tuning; on tunes every estimator listed; auto tunes only the estimators that won or improved in the most recent comparable run. *Per dataset.* |
| `ga_tuning.estimators` | `[elastic_net, catboost]` | list of `elastic_net`, `catboost` (aliases: `elasticnet`->`elastic_net`) | `--ga-estimators` | `tune_elasticnet`, `tune_catboost` | Estimators tuned when mode is on (classification tunes elastic-net logistic regression). *Per dataset.* |
| `ga_tuning.generations` | `12` | int (>= 1) | `--ga-generations` | `ga_generations` | GA generations. *Per dataset.* |
| `ga_tuning.population_size` | `16` | int (>= 2) | `--ga-population-size` | `ga_population_size` | Individuals per generation. *Per dataset.* |
| `ga_tuning.time_budget_min` | `null` (no limit) | float (>= 0.0) | `--ga-time-budget-minutes` | CLI / run.yaml only | Stop starting new generations once this many minutes have elapsed for one estimator. *Per dataset.* |
| `ga_tuning.max_configs` | `null` (no limit) | int (>= 1) | `--ga-max-configs` | CLI / run.yaml only | Stop after this many distinct hyperparameter configurations have been cross-validated. *Per dataset.* |

| `deep.unimol.lr` | `0.0001` | float (>= 0.0) | `--unimol-learning-rate` | CLI / run.yaml only | Learning rate. *Per dataset.* |
| `deep.unimol.batch_size` | `null` (32 on CPU; 32/64/128 by detected GPU memory) | int (>= 1) | `--unimol-batch-size` | CLI / run.yaml only | Mini-batch size. *Per dataset.* |

## 9. Fusion

| Key | Default | Allowed values | CLI flag | Notebook widget | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `fusion.cfa_score` | `true` | true / false | `--run-cfa / --no-run-cfa` | CLI / run.yaml only | Run CFA combinatorial fusion (score combinations) over the best model of each workflow. *Per dataset.* |
| `fusion.cfa_rank` | `true` | true / false | `--cfa-include-rank-combinations / --no-cfa-include-rank-combinations` | CLI / run.yaml only | Also try CFA rank combinations (AC/WCP/WCDS). Has no effect when cfa_score is false. *Per dataset.* |
| `fusion.optimize_metric` | `mae` | `mae`, `rmse`, `roc_auc`, `auprc`, `balanced_accuracy`, `mcc`, `accuracy` | `--cfa-optimize-metric` | CLI / run.yaml only | Training-side metric used to choose the CFA candidate (classification uses the primary metric when a regression metric is given). *Per dataset.* |

## 10. Ensembles

| Key | Default | Allowed values | CLI flag | Notebook widget | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ensemble.oof_stacking` | `true` | true / false | `--ensemble-methods` | CLI / run.yaml only | RidgeCV stacker fitted on the members' out-of-fold training predictions. *Per dataset.* |
| `ensemble.inverse_rmse_average` | `true` | true / false | `--ensemble-methods` | CLI / run.yaml only | Average weighted by inverse member error (out-of-fold under member_selection_metric oof). *Per dataset.* |
| `ensemble.simple_average` | `false` | true / false | `--ensemble-methods` | CLI / run.yaml only | Unweighted average of the members. *Per dataset.* |
| `ensemble.member_selection_metric` | `oof` | `oof`, `cv`, `test` (aliases: `train`->`cv`) | `--ensemble-member-selection-split` | CLI / run.yaml only | Which predictions drive ensemble membership, weights and the stacking meta-model. oof refits each member on K folds of the training split and uses its out-of-fold predictions: leakage-free and not biased toward models that memorise the training set. cv (alias train) uses in-sample training predictions and favours overfit members; it only reproduces the qsarena_benchmark_chemprop_fixed run. test reproduces the originally deposited benchmark run and is optimistically biased. *Per dataset.* |
| `ensemble.oof_folds` | `5` | int (>= 2) | `--ensemble-oof-folds` | CLI / run.yaml only | Folds for the out-of-fold member predictions (member_selection_metric oof). Same fold geometry as cross-validation. *Per dataset.* |
| `ensemble.oof_scope` | `all` | `all`, `cpu` | `--ensemble-oof-scope` | CLI / run.yaml only | Which members may be refitted per fold for out-of-fold predictions. Uni-Mol reuses its saved internal-fold predictions (cv.data) and is not refitted. all also refits Chemprop per fold on the GPU; cpu refits only CPU models, and Chemprop is then left out of the ensemble. *Per dataset.* |
| `ensemble.oof_source_run` | `null` (look only in this run) | text | `--ensemble-oof-source-run` | CLI / run.yaml only | Earlier run directory searched for saved Uni-Mol model folders (cv.data) when building out-of-fold predictions. |
| `ensemble.exclude_negative_test_r2_members` | `true` | true / false | `--ensemble-exclude-negative-test-r2-members / --no-ensemble-exclude-negative-test-r2-members` | CLI / run.yaml only | Drop members with negative R2 on the member-selection split (train when member_selection_metric is cv, so the default is leakage-free). *Per dataset.* |
| `ensemble.drop_correlated_members` | `true` | true / false | `--ensemble-drop-highly-correlated-members / --no-ensemble-drop-highly-correlated-members` | CLI / run.yaml only | Drop one member of each pair whose training predictions are nearly identical. *Per dataset.* |
| `ensemble.max_member_correlation` | `0.995` | float (>= 0.0, <= 1.0) | `--ensemble-max-train-correlation` | CLI / run.yaml only | Correlation above which two members count as redundant. *Per dataset.* |
| `ensemble.stacking_cv_folds` | `5` | int (>= 2) | `--ensemble-stacking-cv-folds` | CLI / run.yaml only | Folds for the out-of-fold stacking predictions. *Per dataset.* |

## 11. Applicability domain

| Key | Default | Allowed values | CLI flag | Notebook widget | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `applicability_domain.method` | `both` | `standardization`, `confidence`, `both`, `off` | `--ad-method` | CLI / run.yaml only | Per-test-molecule domain flags written to applicability_domain.csv. standardization = Roy et al. (2015) descriptor-range rule on the selected features; confidence = predicted-probability confidence \|2p-1\| of the selected model for classification, and k-nearest-neighbour Tanimoto similarity to the training set for regression. Diagnostics only: no metric changes. *Per dataset.* |
| `applicability_domain.confidence_threshold` | `0.5` | float (>= 0.0, <= 1.0) | `--ad-confidence-threshold` | CLI / run.yaml only | Classification: a prediction is in-domain when \|2p-1\| >= this value (0.5 means p <= 0.25 or p >= 0.75). *Per dataset.* |
| `applicability_domain.knn_quantile` | `0.95` | float (>= 0.5, <= 0.999) | `--ad-knn-quantile` | CLI / run.yaml only | Regression: in-domain when the mean Tanimoto distance to the 5 nearest training molecules is at most this quantile of the training set's own leave-one-out distances. *Per dataset.* |

## 12. Evaluation

| Key | Default | Allowed values | CLI flag | Notebook widget | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `evaluation.regression_metrics` | `[rmse, mae, r2, spearman]` | list of `rmse`, `mae`, `r2`, `spearman` | `--report-regression-metrics` | CLI / run.yaml only | Metrics shown in the report tables for regression datasets. metrics.csv always contains all of them. |
| `evaluation.classification_metrics` | `[roc_auc, auprc, balanced_accuracy, mcc]` | list of `roc_auc`, `auprc`, `balanced_accuracy`, `mcc` (aliases: `auroc`->`roc_auc`) | `--report-classification-metrics` | CLI / run.yaml only | Metrics shown in the report tables for classification datasets. |
| `evaluation.primary_metric` | `auto` | `auto`, `rmse`, `mae`, `r2`, `spearman`, `pearson`, `roc_auc`, `auprc`, `balanced_accuracy`, `mcc`, `accuracy` (aliases: `auroc`->`roc_auc`) | `--primary-metric` | CLI / run.yaml only | Metric used to rank models, drive GA tuning and pick the best model. auto = the benchmark's leaderboard metric, else rmse (regression) or roc_auc (classification). *Per dataset.* |

## 13. Model-selection protocol

| Key | Default | Allowed values | CLI flag | Notebook widget | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `selection.protocol` | `both` | `test`, `cv`, `both` | `--selection-protocol` | CLI / run.yaml only | How the report names each dataset's best model. test = best held-out score (optimistic: the test set chooses); cv = best cross-validated training score (honest; only models with CV metrics are eligible); both = report both side by side. |

## 14. Outputs, reporting & caching

| Key | Default | Allowed values | CLI flag | Notebook widget | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `run.output_dir` | `null` (benchmark_results/qsarena_benchmark_<timestamp>) | text | `--output-dir` | CLI / run.yaml only | Directory that receives every artifact and the report. |
| `run.resume` | `true` | true / false | `--resume / --no-resume` | CLI / run.yaml only | Reuse completed datasets and stages already in output_dir when their config signature matches. |
| `run.overwrite` | `false` | true / false | `--fresh` | CLI / run.yaml only | Ignore everything in output_dir and recompute. The old directory is renamed to <name>_superseded_<timestamp>, never deleted. |
| `run.verbosity` | `normal` | `quiet`, `normal`, `verbose`, `debug` | `--verbosity` | CLI / run.yaml only | Console detail and the minimum level written to events.jsonl. run.log always keeps the full console transcript. |
| `report.formats` | `[html, md]` | list of `html`, `md` | (fixed) | CLI / run.yaml only | Locked: every run and batch writes both report.html and report.md. |
| `report.include_plots` | `true` | true / false | `--report-plots / --no-report-plots` | CLI / run.yaml only | Won-by-family, cost-vs-gap and AD-coverage plots (SVG, no plotting library needed). |
| `report.what_next` | `true` | true / false | `--report-what-next / --no-report-what-next` | CLI / run.yaml only | Actionable "what to do next" section. |
| `report.machine_readable_manifest` | `true` | true / false | `--report-manifest / --no-report-manifest` | CLI / run.yaml only | Write report_data.json alongside the reports. |
| `caching.granularity` | `[dataset, stage]` | list of `dataset`, `stage` | `--resume-granularity` | CLI / run.yaml only | dataset reuses fully completed datasets; stage also reuses the split/feature-selection cache and completed model stages inside an interrupted dataset. |
| `caching.validate_against_config_signature` | `true` | true / false | `--validate-resume-signature / --no-validate-resume-signature` | CLI / run.yaml only | Recompute any cached model stage whose recorded config signature differs from the current one. |
| `caching.atomic_writes` | `true` | true / false | `--atomic-writes / --no-atomic-writes` | CLI / run.yaml only | Write every artifact to a temporary file and rename it into place, so an interrupted run never leaves a half-written file. |

## 15. Execution

| Key | Default | Allowed values | CLI flag | Notebook widget | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `run.mode` | `auto` | `auto`, `single`, `batch`, `benchmark` | `--run-mode` | CLI / run.yaml only | single = one or more CSVs given by input.path; batch = batch.source; benchmark = the curated benchmark collection; auto picks batch if batch.source is set, else single if input.path is set, else benchmark. |
| `run.dry_run` | `false` | true / false | `--dry-run` | CLI / run.yaml only | Run preflight checks, print the resolved plan and a cost estimate, write dry_run_plan.{json,md}, then exit without fitting any model. |
| `run.n_jobs` | `0` | int | `--n-jobs` | CLI / run.yaml only | CPU workers for parallel-capable estimators. 0 or negative uses every detected core. |
| `run.parallel_datasets` | `1` | int (>= 1) | `--parallel-datasets` | CLI / run.yaml only | Datasets processed concurrently (process pool). n_jobs is divided between workers. |
| `run.dataset_names` | `[]` | text | `--dataset-name` | CLI / run.yaml only | Benchmark mode only: restrict the curated collection to these dataset names (list them with --dry-run). |
| `batch.source` | `null` | path/name or list | `--batch` | CLI / run.yaml only | A manifest CSV (one row per dataset), a directory of CSVs, a .txt file listing CSV paths, or a list of CSV paths. |
| `batch.mode` | `auto` | `auto`, `manifest`, `directory`, `list` | `--batch-mode` | CLI / run.yaml only | How to read batch.source. auto: directory -> directory; .txt -> list; CSV with a 'path' column -> manifest; several paths -> list. |
| `batch.continue_on_error` | `true` | true / false | `--continue-on-error / --no-continue-on-error` | CLI / run.yaml only | Record a failing dataset (status failed + error + remedy) and continue with the next one. |
| `batch.aggregate_summary` | `true` | true / false | `--aggregate-summary / --no-aggregate-summary` | CLI / run.yaml only | Write dataset_summary.csv with one row per dataset (status, best model, metric, error). |
| `multiseed.enabled` | `true` | true / false | `--run-tdc22-multiseed-best / --no-run-tdc22-multiseed-best` | CLI / run.yaml only | After the run, re-evaluate the selected model of each official TDC ADMET Benchmark Group dataset over several seeds. Datasets outside that group are skipped. |
| `multiseed.seeds` | `5` | int or list of int | `--tdc22-multiseed-seeds` | CLI / run.yaml only | Number of seeds (n means seeds 1..n) or an explicit list of seeds. |

## Model families

`models.enable_families` and the report's won-by-family plot use these families:

- `conventional_ml`: scikit-learn models: ElasticNetCV/LogisticRegression, SVR/SVC, random forest, extra trees, HistGradientBoosting, KNN+SVM voting, AdaBoost, tabular MLP (and their GA-tuned versions)
- `gradient_boosting`: XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost and MapLight CatBoost (needs qsarena[boosting])
- `deep_tabular`: ChemML MLP (PyTorch/TensorFlow), tabular CNN (TensorFlow) and TabPFN (needs qsarena[deep] / qsarena[foundation])
- `graph_nn`: Chemprop v2 graph variants (needs qsarena[graph])
- `pretrained_3d`: Uni-Mol V1/V2 pretrained 3D models (needs qsarena[foundation]; V2 needs a GPU)
- `maplight_gnn`: MapLight + GNN (CatBoost on MapLight features plus GIN embeddings; needs dgl/dgllife)
- `fusion`: CFA combinatorial fusion
- `ensemble`: OOF stacking / weighted / simple-average ensembles
